After going over the integration details, you will be directed to the software provider’s website on a new browser tab. The steps that need to be completed at this stage depend on the software provider.

After all steps have been completed, your activation initiation is sent for approval. The activation initiation is confirmed (or rejected) in a matter of minutes.

 

6. Receive Confirmation About the Integration

In the final step of the activation process, you will see a confirmation of your activation’s status. If you initiated the activation for multiple Procountor environments, you can track the status of each one.

The status information is available in the following places:

  1. The same pop-up window used during the activation process (the window can be closed).
  2. Procountor’s front page, in the “Hello” widget. The front page will display the status of your most recent integration activations.
  3. The email sent to you once all requests have been processed.

 

Activation request(s) approved

Congratulations, the integration is now “open for business”! If you have any remaining questions about how to use the features unlocked by the integration, please refer to the instructions included on the Procountor Store page or the software provider’s support page.

 

Activation request(s) rejected

If your activation request was rejected, you can start the process from the beginning. The integration provider will often state the reason for the rejection, which helps you take any required actions before initiating another request. Sometimes, the activation request may also fail due to a “timeout.” In these cases, please try again.

If your activation requests continue to be rejected and you are unsure how to resolve the issue, please contact the integration provider.

 

Looking for information on how to maintain and remove your integrations? See this article.

articles.name: Procountor mobile - Receipts
articles.title: Procountor mobile - Receipts
articles.body:
• With the Procountor mobile app, you can quickly take photos of receipts and save their details—even while on the go.
  • The app includes built-in optical character recognition (OCR) technology. This means the text content of the receipt is automatically read from the image and filled into the receipt fields in the app.
  • Additionally, automatic AI-based expense categorization suggests a suitable expense type for the receipt using artificial intelligence. (NEW feature on October 9, 2025!)
  • Captured receipts can be attached to expense or purchase invoices. These invoices can be created either in the mobile app or, if needed, in the browser version of Procountor—by the person who took the photo or, for example, by an accountant.

How to photograph receipts using the app

Start creating a receipt

From the app’s home screen, tap Create new > Receipt.

Take a photo of the receipt

When taking a photo for the first time, the app will ask for permission to use your device’s camera. Allow access by tapping OK.

If you need more light, tap the flashlight icon in the top left corner.

You can also upload receipts saved in your phone’s photo gallery by tapping the Gallery icon in the bottom right corner.

To access receipts saved in your phone’s file storage, tap the Files button in the bottom left corner.

Crop the receipt

The app will automatically try to detect the edges of the receipt and crop it accordingly. You can manually adjust the crop area by dragging the frame edges. This helps with further processing in accounting.

Confirm the receipt

Once the photo is taken, tap the Done button.

If needed, you can retake the photo by tapping Retake.

Review the details

The app reads the receipt’s details and fills them in automatically. You can only enter one receipt’s details at a time.

The app’s built-in AI feature (added on October 9, 2025) interprets the receipt and suggests a suitable expense type using artificial intelligence. You can change the suggested type if needed. The available expense types come from your Procountor environment’s fixed travel and expense product register. A correctly selected expense type helps, for example, your accountant to allocate the expense properly in Procountor.

You can edit the recognized details directly in the app or in the browser version of Procountor. Required fields include: payment method, purchase date, amount, and VAT percentage.

Available payment methods for receipts:

  • Company credit card
  • Company debit card
  • Company cash
  • Company bank transfer
  • Personal funds

Add any attachments

You can add additional attachments to the receipt using the Add attachment button.

Attach the receipt to an invoice

How the expense invoice is created depends on the selected payment method.

Creating an expense invoice in the app:

If the payment method is Personal funds, the app automatically creates an expense invoice from the receipt when you save the receipt details.

If you have an unfinished expense invoice, the app will automatically add the receipt to that invoice.

Once the expense invoice is ready, send it for review. This allows the receipt to be reviewed by relevant parties, such as supervisors or accountants.

Who receives the invoice for approval depends on the approval workflow settings defined in your personal profile.

Creating an expense or purchase invoice in the Procountor software:

If the payment method is anything other than Personal funds, the receipt will be transferred to Receipt

Management in the Procountor software after you tap Done.

Depending on your organization’s workflow, either you or, for example, your accountant can continue processing the receipt and attach it to an invoice via Receipt Management in Procountor.

articles.name: Guidance for accountants regarding VAT changes in the Finago Procountor Solo environment
articles.title: Guidance for accountants regarding VAT changes in the Finago Procountor Solo environment
articles.body:
On this page, we have compiled information and considerations for accountants regarding the VAT change concerning Finago Procountor Solo environments. The page will be updated when more information is released.

 

VAT rate change 14% -> 13,5 % (Jan 1st 2026)

From the beginning of 2026, the VAT rate for several goods is decreasing from 14% to 13.5%

The purchase product register in Solo is managed in Procountor through the accountant's interface. Therefore, VAT changes for purchase products can be made by the accountant in Procountor.

  • The VAT configuration tool (Management > Accounting Info > VAT Defaults) can be used to update other Solo items to the new 13,5% VAT rate.
  • Existing VAT information will not automatically change in the product register or on invoices, so the VAT change requires action from the user (accountant).

 

How do I change the VAT percentage in Finago Procountor Solo environment?

  • On January 1st, we automatically add the new percentage to Sales invoices and purchases in the Used VAT percentages.
  • The product register of Finago Procountor Solo environments (Registers > Product Register for purchases) is not automatically updated with a new VAT-% and you can use VAT configuration tool to update it with the new VAT-%.

 

Updating the product register for Solo environment

The entrepreneur allocates each purchase invoice and expense in the Solo user interface based on the expense type. These expense types come from the Procountor Product register for purchases, and all purchase products added to Procountor are also visible for the entrepreneur.

The product register of the Solo environment is not automatically updated with a new VAT-%.

 

VAT configuration tool

The VAT configuration tool allows for the mass updating of the new VAT percentage of 13.5% to various places and settings in Procountor. The configuration tool can be accessed from Management > Accounting Info > VAT Defaults. The tool can be used to update the VAT-% for product register, when they include a VAT-% with 14%.

Discuss with the entrepreneur what is an appropriate time to update the VAT-%. If invoices with the new VAT percentage start arriving from the entrepreneur already in December, it is also advisable to update / add the new VAT-% to the product register so that the VAT details also correct on the bank statements.

It is the accountant's responsibility to ensure that the correct VAT-% is used in invoicing and accounting.

The new VAT-% (13,5%) can also be added to Procountor by creating manually products in the product register with the new VAT-%. This way, the entrepreneur can choose the expense type in their interface with either the new or the old VAT-%. Read below how to do this.

 

Creating double products to the product register with the new VAT-%

  1. Navigate in the accountant’s interface in Procountor to the section Registers > Product register for purchases.
  2. Select the product you want to copy and press the Copy button on the top row.
  3. Enter the product name and select a new VAT percentage for the product. We recommend that you name the products in such a way that the entrepreneur can choose the correct expense type (with the old or new VAT percentage) in their own interface.
  4. Finally, press the Copy button.
  •  

 

VAT rate change 10% -> 14 % (Jan 1st 2025)

From the beginning of 2025, the VAT rate for several goods increased from 10% to 14%.

The purchase product register in Solo is managed in Procountor through the accountant's interface. Therefore, VAT changes for purchase products can be made by the accountant in Procountor.

  • The VAT configuration tool added for the 2024 VAT changes will be expanded in January 2025 so that from January 18, 2025, it can be used to change the VAT rate of multiple products to 14% at once.
  • Changes to the VAT rates of products can also be made manually directly in the product register before January 18. You can change the VAT rate of an existing product or add a completely new product with a new rate.
  • Existing VAT information will not automatically change in the product register or on invoices, so the VAT change requires action from the user (accountant).
  •

articles.name: Salaries reporting
articles.title: Salaries reporting
articles.body:
Salaries reporting view is found in Reports > Salaries reporting. The reporting offers the information in real time from Procountor's database

Salaries reporting view is used to observe the development of salaries from the perspectives of salary types, salary categories, income types, persons and person groups.

 

Creating a report

  1. First, define the search criteria for the report.
  2. Click Apply.
  3. The program generates salary reports in line with the search criteria.

Reset to default: clears your selections and resets the default search criteria.

View details: In details view there is a table which shows row level data from salary slips:

  • Each column has sorting functionality for ascending/descending order.
  • Table can be exported to Excel in the default order by payslip number. 
  • The Back button returns you to the main view of the report.

 

Search criteria

It is possible to filter salary slip data by:

Time period

  • Current period
  • Current holiday year
  • Current year
  • Previous year
  • Custom period: Free date definition either by filling values in the fields or by using the calendar icon. 

 

Figures

  • Payday: with this selection, the report values will be formed by the paydays of salary slips.
  • Receipt date: with this selection, the report values will be formed by the receipt dates of salary slips.

 

Salary slip status

Salary slips to be included in the report can be filtered by their statuses. This is done by clicking the names of the statuses. 

  • Approved
  • In correction
  • Marked paid
  • Paid
  • Partly paid
  • Payment queued
  • Payment set to bank
  • Reported
  • Unfinished

 

Salary types, Salary categories or Income types

This search criterion is used to make more specific determinations about the salary types, salary categories and income types to be included in the report. All salary types are included by default.

  • You can filter the search by changing the tab according to salary types, salary categories and income types.
  • Choose from the list which salary type, category or income type you want to include in the report. With the Select all button, you select all the information on the tab. Use the Clear selection button to clear all selections.
  • Search field: You can filter the list by entering any part of the name of salary types, salary categories or income types. 

 

Person and Person group

This search criterion is used to make more specific determinations about the persons and person groups to be included in the report. All persons are included by default.

  • You can filter the search by changing the tab according to Persons and Person groups.
  • Choose from the list which person or person group you want to include in the report. With the Select all button, you select all the information on the tab. Use the Clear selection button to clear all selections.
  • Search field: You can filter the list by entering any part of the name of person or person group.

 

Person's  salary information

When only one person is selected, there is an additional panel showing the tax card and other salary information of the employee.

 

The available graphs

Upper graph: Salaries overview

The topmost graph presents a salaries overview, i.e. total salaries grouped by day / month / year, depending on the selected date range.

By pressing the Report type drop down menu, you can also choose whether to display the graph:

  • Salaries by type: Total salaries grouped by salary type 
  • Salaries by category: Total salaries grouped by salary category 
  • Salaries by income type: Total salaries grouped by income type 

The graph can be saved as a PNG-format image file by clicking on the Export to PNG button.

 

Lower graph

The lower report provides a pivot table grouping the data by Salary type, Salary category or Income type, where data is presented on day/month/year level, depending on the selected date range. Data in each of the tables can also be grouped separately.

Click on the image to enlarge it.

  • By default the sum row for each of the groups is visible, and user can expand the panel to see the data in more detail by clicking the arrow icon.
  • There is also a sum column and sum row for all the content in the table.
  • Columns can be sorted in ascending/descending order by clicking on the column's header. The table visible in UI can be exported to Excel.  
  • Excel export button export the report data to an Excel file.

articles.name: Cashflow reporting
articles.title: Cashflow reporting
articles.body:
Cashflow report can be used to observe the balances of bank accounts from the perspectives of past, present and future. The report is also able to forecast the future cash flows from Procountor’s future transactions that have not yet created actual cash processes. The reporting offers the information in real time from Procountor's database

The Cashflow report is found in Reports > Cashflow reporting.

 

Creating a report

  1. First, define the search criteria for the report.
  2. Click Apply.
  3. The program generates cashflow reports in line with the search criteria.

Reset to default: clears your selections and resets the default search criteria.

View details: From the View details -button on the top row, you can view the content of the graph at the row level.

 

  • From the details view the user can view individual bank statement events from the bank accounts chosen as well as open receipts by due date.
  • Table can be exported to Excel by pressing Export to Excel button.
  • The Back button returns you to the main view of the report.

 

Search criteria

It is possible to filter the graph by:

Time period

  • 2+1 months: two previous months and the following month
  • 2+2 weeks: two previous weeks and two following weeks
  • 10+2 months: 10 previous months and two following months
  • Current year
  • Custom period: Free date definition either by filling values in the fields or by using the calendar icon.

Bank accounts

  • Listing of accounts: The account or accounts to be included in the report can also be chosen from the listing of accounts below the Search field. A single account is activated by clicking it. Choosing multiple accounts is possible only when the accounts are in the same currency.
    • If you have accounts in different currencies, they are separated into their own tabs. 
  •  With the Select all button, you select all the information on the tab. Use the Clear selection button to clear all selections.
  • Search field: You can filter the list by entering any part of the account.

Transactions

  • All transactions: searches for both business transactions and other transactions.
  • Business transactions: this selection includes business transactions to the report: business transactions are receipts that are in statuses Not sent, Sent, Paid, Approved, Partly paid, Marked paid or Invoiced.
  • Other transactions: this selection includes transactions, that are not business transactions, to the report.

Receipt type

This selection determines the receipt types to be included in the report. If there are no receipts of a specific receipt type in the environment, the receipt type in question is not listed in this menu. The available receipt types are:

  • Expense invoices
  • Purchase invoices
  • Purchase orders
  • Salaries
  • Sales invoices
  • Sales orders
  • Tax returns for self-assessed taxes
  • Travel invoices

Scope

All invoices, overdue (past due) and/or due (future due) invoices can be selected separately into report.

 

The available graphs

Cash flow history and future

The topmost graph in the Cash flow report view depicts the development of the balance of the selected account and estimated development of its balance (deposits, withdrawals, future deposits and future withdrawals for the selected account) during the selected time interval.

The Balance graph indicates the actual balance of the bank account.

The Future Balance graph shows a forecast of the future balance of the bank account.

The graph can be saved as a PNG-format image file by clicking on the Export to PNG button.

 

Cashflow report

The graph in the middle illustrates the actual cash flow and forecast divided into deposits and withdrawals. Purple bars illustrate deposits, light purple bars correspondingly withdrawals. Grey bars are forecasts of the future withdrawals and the blue bars are future deposits.

The graph can be saved as a PNG-format image file by clicking on the Export to PNG button.

 

Future details

The lowest section of the Cash flow report a Future details grid  shows the receipts that are expected to have an impact on the bank account balance in the future.

Click on the image to enlarge it.

  • Columns can be sorted in ascending/descending order by clicking on the column's header.
  • By clicking on the arrow on the right side of the line, you can drill down to view forecasts on a daily / monthly level depending on the period you define. At the same time, this changes the upper graphs to show actuals and forecasts for that day / month.
    • If you want to go back to the search criteria you previously defined, you have to define the search criteria again.

articles.name: Filtering and editing invoices
articles.title: Filtering and editing invoices
articles.body:
You can find already created invoices and receipts by navigating to their search using the buttons at the bottom of the application:

  • Receipts (includes photographed receipts and expense claims with an attached receipt)
  • Trips (includes travel expense claims)
  • Invoices (includes all invoices: you can filter the search by invoice type)

Your Procountor user rights affect which receipts you can see in the application. For example, if you do not have access rights to purchase or sales invoices, they will not be visible in the application.

Receipts are grouped monthly.

 

Receipt search criteria

In the Receipts section, you can search separately for receipts or expense invoices. Receipts can be also filtered according to the payment method or limit the search to a specific time.

  • Use the Sort button to determine whether the search results are shown from newest to oldest or vice versa.
  • Use the Magnifying Glass to search for documents based on words/numbers appearing in them.

 

Invoice search criteria

In the Invoices section, you can search for all invoices or alternatively narrow the search to a specific invoice type by selecting Filter.

  • From the Filter button, you can filter the invoices displayed in the list. You can specify the date range for which you are searching for invoices or search for only certain types of invoices. The options available are:
    • All (default)
    • Purchase invoice
    • Tax invoice %
    • Sales invoice
    • Travel invoice
    • Expense invoice

The search options after selecting the invoice type vary depending on the selection of each invoice type. For example, if you search for travel or expense invoices from the Invoices tab, you can also select the person whose invoice you are looking for. And when searching for purchase invoices, you can choose the supplier whose invoices you are searching for, and correspondingly, in Sales invoices, you can narrow down according to customers if you wish.

  • Use the Sort button to determine whether the search results are shown from newest to oldest or vice versa.
  • Use the Magnifying Glass to search for documents based on words/numbers appearing in them.

 

Trips search criteria

In the Trips section, you can search by the purpose of the trip or filter the search results to apply to a specific period of time.

  • Use the Sort button to determine whether the search results are shown from newest to oldest or vice versa.
  • Use the Magnifying Glass to search for documents based on words/numbers appearing in them.

 

Editing invoices

You can edit pending or received invoices as follows:

1. Open the invoice you want to edit.

2. In the invoice view, select the section you want to edit: daily allowances, kilometers, or expenses.

3. If you want to edit, for example, daily allowances, press the Daily Allowances section to go to the Daily Allowances view. Select the amount to edit or add a new one by pressing the Add New button.

  • Edit the information, such as the amount and VAT percentage.
  • Finally press Done.

  • You can also delete an invoice row by going to the row details and pressing the Delete button. If there is only one row on the invoice, it cannot be deleted.

articles.name: Advanced user management
articles.title: Advanced user management
articles.body:
Advanced user management - view enables editing several users’ user privileges at the same time. Advanced user management is a part of Procountor's Accounting firm tools for partners.

  • With Advanced user management it is possible to manage user rights of several users or remove user/users from several environments in one go. Also, it is possible to copy certain user rights to selected users.

The Advanced user management -view is an updated version of the old Advanced user management -view.

After release v84 old Advanced user management view will be disabled and users will be using the new view called Advanced user management launched previously last year. Also the word 'New' has been removed from the new view's name. All functionality of the old view is now in new view and users can use and change user rights the same way as before.

You need at least the following user rights to access the view:

  • Accounting firm tools
  • Rights to the Users and privileges of environments listed (Viewing rights/All)
  • In order to use the Advanced user management, the user must have the privileges to user management in the environment he/she is going to use the Advanced user management function.
    • With the viewing rights the user can only observe the user rights but not edit them.
  • it is not possible to modify user rights of a person who has Employee role.

The Advanced user management -view's key updates:

  • You can search for companies by product version or by user role
  • Editing user rights has been updated.

 

 

Top row buttons

Search

  • Button lists the search results.
  • After selecting Search criteria to the Company and User sections, this button lists users and their rights to the search results.

Save

  • Button saves the changes made on the view.

Create a new user

  • Button enables creating a new user ID.

Add users to environments

  • Button opens a new view
  • You can select several users and the environments to which the users will be added.
  • Read more about the function here.

 

Search criteria

Product version

  • You can search for companies by their product version.
  • You can choose Procountor Financials, Procountor Ledger or Finago Procountor Solo

Role

  • You can search for those users who have the role you selected from the list.

Company

  • Company or companies can be selected from the list.
  • Users can be either scanned from the list or searched by using the search function.

User

  • The users on the list are automatically updated depending on the selected company.
  • User or users can be selected from the list.
  • Users can be either scanned from the list or searched by using the search function.
  • Selected users section shows the users that are selected, and the company’s name is in brackets.

 

Search results

1. First define the search criteria.

2.  Search-button creates a list of search results formed according to the Search criteria. 

 

  • The number of users matching the search criteria is shown in brackets in the Search results
  • As a default only the buttons Export and Select are active when no users are selected from the search results.
    • Export button exports the search result to either Excel or HTML.
    • Select button enables to select all the users listed in the Search results or clear the selections.

Remove

  • Button removes one or more selected users from the company selected in the search criteria.
  • When clicking the button, a new view opens. On the opening view the users to be removed must be confirmed.
  • In the brackets is shown the name of the company where the users are removed.
  • By selecting Remove user/users are removed, and by selecting Cancel it is possible to return without removing user/users from the environment in question.

Copy rights

  • Button activates when one user has been selected. That person’s user rights can then be copied to other user/users.
  • After clicking Copy rights, select those users these rights are wanted to be copied. When all the wanted users are selected, Paste rights button is active and can be clicked.

Paste rights

  • Button opens new window, on which it can be checked, what rights are copied to which user.
  • Selecting Copy will save the change, Cancel button will close the window without making changes to user rights.

User right changes

  • Button opens a window, that shows the user right changes made to the user.
  • The window also shows information about the changes, such as, the time, editor, user right that has been edited, old and new value of the user right and the type of change.
  • The information is possible to get in HTML, Excel or PDF format.

 

Creating a new user

When a person to be added does not already have the existing Procountor username, proceed according to the following instructions:

 

1. Click on Create a new user button, which will open Add user window.

2. Enter the user’s first and last name, on which the username will be based on.

3. Enter the rest of the user’s personal information. Mandatory information are user’s phone number and email.

4. Choose whether the username and password are sent to user by email or text message, or will you deliver them personally.

5. After filling out the necessary information, click on Add user to environment button.

6. On the opening view, select the companies, to which the user is wanted to be added. Also, select the user role and the home environment for the user.

7. View that the entered information is correct, and make the necessary changes before saving.

8. Click on Save.

9.After saving Procountor gives a notification: “User Manager, Mike (mike.manager) has been created.”

  • If you chose that the username and password will be sent automatically to the user Procountor gives a notification: “Username and login instructions will be sent to: mike@company.xxx. Password will be sent to number +358 00 000 0000.”
  • If you chose to deliver the username and the password personally, Procountor will open a new window, on which the new user’s username and password are showing. The username and password should be copied and pasted to be saved and delivered.

10. After saving Procountor takes you back to the Advanced user management view and shows the changes in Search results section.

 

Adding users to Procountor environments

 

When the purpose is to add user with the existing username and password to environment or environments, proceed according to the following instructions:

 

1. Click on the Add users to environments button.

2. Select the users to be added.

  • Users can be either scanned from the list or searched on the search field.

3. Select the environments, where the users are wanted to be added.

4. The role of the users to be added can be defined on the Role field.

5. At the bottom of the view there is a Changes to be made when saving section, in which the information is updated while the new changes are made. Verify the information and edit if necessary.

6. Save button saves the changes without asking for confirmation. After saving Procountor takes you back to the Advanced user management view and shows the changes in Search results section.

 

Copying the user rights to another user

1. First define the search criteria and click on Search.

2. Select the user whose user rights you want to copy to another user.

3. Click on Copy rights button.

  • After clicking on Copy rights button, the Paste rights button activates.

4. Select the user to whom the copied rights are wanted to be pasted.

5. Click on Paste rights button. After clicking on the button, Procountor will ask to confirm the copying of the user rights. By clicking on Copy, the user rights are copied and by clicking on Cancel the process is canceled.

 

Editing user rights

 

1. First define the search criteria and click on Search.

2. Make the necessary edits to the user rights.

  • In the Search results, the name of the environment, that the user rights are concerning, is shown below the user’s name.
  • Each environment is separately shown in the Search results, which means that if the user is in several environments, the user’s rights in each environment are separately shown.

3. The user’s user rights can be edited either by changing the user’s role or by editing each user right separately.

4. Save the changes by clicking on Save button. After clicking on the button, Procountor will give a notification about saving the information.

Editing of user rights is done in the same way as with the Users and user rights -view.

 

Removing the user from the environment

1. First define the search criteria and click on Search.

2. Select the user/users, whose user rights to the environment are wanted to be removed.

3. Click on Remove button. Clicking the Remove button opens a new window, on which you must confirm removing the rights of the selected users. Clicking on Remove removes the user rights and clicking on Cancel cancels the process.

articles.name: Bank statement entry reconciliation
articles.title: Bank statement entry reconciliation
articles.body:
Bank statement entry reconciliation -view can be used to allocate unhandled bank statement entries to 1 appropriate matching cost receipt. Transactions and attachments of the matching cost receipt can be viewed while doing so. Also transactions can be edited, deleted, copied, added and accounting account changed.

Bank statement entry reconciliation -view can be opened from 3 places:

1. Via Bank statement entry reconciliation button on top of Search > Cost receipt management view. 

2. Via Bank statement entry reconciliation button on top of Payments > Bank statements and reference payments view.

3. Via Bank statement entry reconciliation button in New cost receipts widget in Procountor's front page.

 

You need at least the following user rights to access the view:

  • Procountor-mobile activated
  • All rights to Bank Statements and reference payments

 

Bank statement entry reconciliation

When the view is opened, unhandled bank statement entries from the latest bank statement are shown. 

1. First define the search criteria.

You can search for unhandled bank statement entries using the following search criteria:

  • Account number
    • Select the account from the dropdown menu for which you want to search for unhandled entries.
  • Bank statement number
    • lists statements from the time after the last closed financial period
    • You can search for entries from all bank statements by selecting an empty row from the dropdown menu. When an empty row is selected, the start and end dates must be within the same month.
  • Start date and end date
    • The start and end dates are determined from the most recent bank statement, if available. The end date cannot be before the start date.

2. Press Search button.

3. The program lists unhandled bank statement entries according to your search criteria. The newest ones are shown first. In the Bank statement entries section, choose the entry you want by pressing it.

4. Next select the matching cost receipt from the Cost receipts section.

5. Edit cost receipt's transactions if needed, in the Transaction information section.

6. Press Save -button. Save –button activates, when matching cost receipt for selected bank statement entry is selected.  The program will inform you that the attachment/attachments of the cost receipts have been successfully added to the transaction. 

  • If edited cost receipt’s transactions and total transactions sum differs from the selected bank statement entry’s original sum, you will have an option to reconcile. Adding reconciliation row is optional. New transaction rows added to transaction grid also appear in Payments > Banks statement and reference payment’s accounting.

  • When a cost receipt is allocated to a bank statement entry, its attachments and updated transactions (if it was changed) can be viewed from Payments > Bank statements and reference payments.

     

Bank statement entries

After you have defined the search criteria and pressed Search button, the program lists the unhandled bank statement entries. Bank statement entries can be sorted by Purchase date, Name, Sum and Message and are listed by Purchase date newest first, by default.

 

Which bank statement entries are listed?

Only those bank statement entries that meet all the following conditions are listed: 

  • Without linked cost receipt
  • That are not allocated to salary or purchase invoice
  • Belong to time after the last closed financial period
  • Doesn’t have a rule for posting default (Management > Accounting info > posting defaults > Bank statement posting default).
    • Those entries that match bank statement posting default for 721 card payment transactions will be shown. 
  • Unhandled bank statement entries matching the bank statement posting default for 720 withdrawal are visible.
  • It's matching cost receipt has at least 1 attachment
  • Has negative sum
  • Has only 1 default transaction in bank statement accounting for its matching cost receipt

 

Cost receipt

After you have defined the search criteria and pressed Search button, the program lists the proposed cost receipts in Cost receipt -section.

 

Which cost receipts are listed?

Maximum 50 cost receipt proposals are shown in Cost receipts grid.

At least two of the following conditions must match the account statement entry:

  • Bank statement entry’s Name of Seller
  • Date (purchase date). Cost receipt date can  be up to 5 days before the Value date or Payment date in the bank statement entry. 
  • Sum in the cost receipt and unhandled bank statement entry must match

The receipt must also have the following details:

  • Is unhandled
  • Has attachment(s)
  • Payment method is Debit card or Bank transfer

 

Attachment -panel

The attachment panel shows matching cost receipt’s attachment’s and it’s details can be viewed. Panel is collapsible, and you can open or close it from the arrow button.

  • It is not possible to add or delete attachments from this view.

 

Transaction information

Transaction information -section lists the transactions of the selected receipt. For example you can edit transactions, delete them or add new ones.

Save transactions for the selected entry toggle button

  • accounting behind the cost receipt can be used during allocation. This is optional as you can choose to save only the attachment of the cost receipt without saving its transactions.

Add transaction

  • The button will add a new transaction row to the cost receipt.

Copy transaction

  • The button will copy the selected transaction and the new, copied row will be added below the original transaction.

Delete transaction

  • The button will delete the active transaction row / receipt row.

Select account

  • The button will open a new window, from which you can select the account for the active transaction.

If dimensions have been added they are also shown and you can edit them.

Transaction with empty VAT% will be automatically converted to 0% and highlighted with yellow background. Hovering on it will show why. 

If edited cost receipt’s transactions and total transactions sum differs from the selected bank statement entry’s original sum, you will have an option to reconcile. Adding reconciliation row is optional. New transaction rows added to transaction grid also appear in Payments > Banks statement and reference payment’s accounting.
